page.layout: Running head across the top: left "& affinitatū.", centre-right "CAPUT XIX." and page number 485 at top right. One text column with no marginal notes. Within the column: two paragraphs, a bracketed diagram of six lines, then one final paragraph. Below the text: gathering signature "Hh 3", centred.

main_text.p: Vocabulorum, quæ arbor hæc exhibet, co-gnitio,graduum item numeratio, & quoto quæ-libet persona alterâ attingat, notitia, tam Theologis, quàm Jureconsultis necessaria est: utrisque propter causas matrimoniales, & licitas, atque illicitas nuptias: Jurecoss. verò in speciem, pro-pter successiones hæreditatum & tutelas, quia vi-delicet hæreditates & tutelæ ad proximū quem-que agnatum redire legibus consueverunt. Lege insuper judiciorum publicorum, contra agnatos & affines testimonium invitus dicere nemo co-gitur. Vocabula autem & gradus cognationum in rectâ linea ascendente & descendente tam sunt nota, eque[?] arbore propositâ tam cuivis obvia, ut ulteriori explicatione opus habere non videan-tur. In linea collaterali paulò major cùm sit diffi-cultas, illa explanabo
PETRUCIUS ergo, seu hypotheticus, ut vo-cant, hoc est, stipes, de cujus cognatione quæri-tur, in linea transversa æquali à latere habet
main_text.l: duarum sororum. Et hi sunt consobrini, quasi consororini.
duorum fratrum. Et hi sunt patrueles.
fratris & sororis, qui sunt amiti-ni, vel amitinæ.

l.bl: omnes hi & singuli vocantur ge-schwisterte kinder.

main_text.p: 3 Consobrinorum, patruelium, & amitino-rum liberi vocantur sobrini, hoc est, andere ge-schwisterte kinder/oder geschwisterte kindskinder/hoc est, fratris aut sororis nepotes, aut neptes.

page.notes: Printed page number "485" is followed by a mark that may be a long-s-like form or a stop; read as 485. Bracket diagram: levels read from the braces; "2 Horum liberos, qui aut sunt" is a box at level 1 that opens the braced items at level 2. "eque" may be "æque" with ligature; uncertain, marked [?]. Black-letter German in the diagram and the last paragraph is set in Fraktur and is marked with bl. Line-end hyphens are kept as printed.
